specification.problem: Implement a single-qubit POVM via a discrete-time quantum walk (polarisation qubit plus position degree of freedom), realised as a Naimark-type dilation. The abstract names three POVMs: Trine, SIC, and unambiguous state discrimination (USD). No explicit equations or parameters are given.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful construction: the Trine POVM on one polarisation qubit, using a generic Naimark-style dilation with a position register of 3 sites. The SIC POVM, USD, and the optical layout, wave-plate angles and experimental results are out of scope.

symbols.meaning: Bloch-sphere pure state defining Trine element k
isometry from polarisation space into polarisation-position space
walker position basis state, x in {0,1,2}, read out as the outcome k
azimuthal angle of Trine direction k on the equator

equations.label: POVM completeness and Born rule
equations.description: General definition of a POVM and its outcome probabilities.
equations.justification: Standard definition of a generalised measurement; the abstract only names POVMs.

equations.label: Trine POVM elements
equations.description: Three rank-1 elements with Bloch vectors equally spaced on an equatorial great circle, with theta_k = 2 pi k/3 for k=0,1,2.
equations.abstract_quote: POVM elements uniformly distributed on an equatorial plane of the Bloch sphere
equations.justification: Uniform distribution on the equator for three elements implies 120-degree spacing; the 2/3 weight follows from sum E_k = I. The use of exactly three elements is the standard Trine, assumed here.
assumptions: Three elements; equal weights; equator is the xy plane (the choice of plane is a convention).

equations.label: Dilation isometry
equations.description: Isometry mapping the input qubit to polarisation and position. The position outcome k has probability p_k = <phi|E_k|phi>.
equations.justification: Generic Naimark-type dilation. The abstract states the walk realises the POVM but not this specific construction.
assumptions: Implementable by a walk with polarisation-dependent displacement and wave-plate rotations; the actual angles are not given.

equations.label: Walk step structure
equations.latex: U=\prod_{t}\left(S\,(C_t\otimes I_{\mathrm{pos}})\right),\quad S=|H\rangle\langle H|\otimes T_{+}+|V\rangle\langle V|\otimes T_{-}
equations.description: Generic quantum-walk unitary: wave-plate coin operations C_t alternating with a polarisation-dependent shift S, where T_pm shifts position by one site.
equations.abstract_quote: polarisation-dependent translation is performed via birefringent beam displacers and a change of the polarisation is implemented with the help of wave-plates
equations.justification: Describes the stated roles of displacers (conditional shift) and wave-plates (polarisation rotation). The coin angles and number of steps are not given.
assumptions: Shift sign convention and the number of steps are placeholders.

registers.name: pos
registers.role: walker position; the final site labels the POVM outcome k

specification.initial_state: |\phi\rangle_{pol}\otimes|0\rangle_{pos}, with |\phi\rangle an arbitrary input polarisation state

steps.description: Prepare the input polarisation state and set the walker at the initial position.
Apply the walk (wave-plate coins plus displacer shifts) that realises the dilation V. The coin angles must be solved so that V matches eq_3.
Detect the photon position; the site k gives the outcome with probability p_k=Tr(E_k rho).

specification.measurement: Photon-counting detection in the position basis (polarisation is discarded or ignored); the site k corresponds to POVM outcome k.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Estimate p_k from normalised count frequencies and compare with Tr(E_k rho) for the Trine elements.
assumptions: No scope was provided, so the Trine POVM was chosen as the one smallest construction.
The 3-site dilation is a generic choice; the actual experimental walk layout and number of steps are unknown.
